source.implements: one box as a footnote: its conditions' labels (fnCond), its effects' labels (effects.js fxLabel; a pick's options, its part), the weapons or models its scope names (none of this kind: no footnote), less what the list printed into the weapons (dmBaked, marked +); none where the unit lacks the keyword or wargear it needs (selfKw, selfGear); a box for one weapon's A, S, AP or D only, not a Damaged band's or a stratagem's, is that weapon's row value ("8 (+6)", "A 6"); a stratagem's one phase from its derived phases and turn
the weapons of the unit a box's scope names, of this kind: by name or its head word, by weapon keyword, by the part of an attached unit (19.04)

the lines under a unit's profile: the stat boxes (BOXES st) of the list's army and detachment rules that reach it (reach, else needs), "{conditions}: OC 7 (rule)"; the characteristic with the effect where every profile has one value and the box is for all models, else the effect's label with a keyword's models; none the list printed into the value (from); "If (see the rule)" for only quoted conditions (verify/lines.js LS)
